master: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished art-direction master board for an ORIGINAL GradeCrew top-down educational escape adventure, working title "Expedition – Das verschwundene Leuchtfeuer". Four equal large landscape panels in a clean 2 by 2 grid, full rectangular image. The four attached images are STYLE AND CAMERA REFERENCES only, not edit targets. Match their actual elevated bird's-eye game camera, miniature chibi proportions, rich layered foliage, rounded but detailed sculpted rocks, warm diffuse daylight, soft shadows, clear pathways, saturated natural grass, believable shallow water, tidy tile-based geography. No low-poly polygon art, no primitive spheres/cube trees, no illustrated brushwork: finished high-quality stylized 3D GAMEPLAY view. Camera about 60 degrees down, north fixed, no horizon; player small (about 7% of panel height), all footpaths and interaction positions readable. Original player: child explorer, ochre knit cap, teal waistcoat over cream shirt, brown shorts, small cream backpack, dark boots. Original NPCs, no Pokémon, no copied trainers, logos, characters or game maps. PANEL 1: sunny coastal village arrival, honey-colored stone square, two small cream cottages terracotta roofs, fountain, one friendly harbor keeper, exit path framed by hedges. PANEL 2: woodland footpath, organically layered leafy trees, stone retaining cliff, small crossing, an old natural wood direction sign, a gardener near gate. PANEL 3: sandy beach, rich blue sea bottom edge and gentle foam, warm rocks sides, a wooden jetty with three distinct rope attachment fixtures, fisher NPC, one conspicuous shell collectible beside path. PANEL 4: ancient pale limestone ruin raised terrace, broad central stairs, six sculpted columns, three closed lantern niches, a child explorer and archivist, visible ocean through surrounding foliage. World fills every panel edge, no black void. Quiet composition, subtle readable details; little UI: only small bottom ivory dialogue box in village panel, leave box blank. No typography except small simple panel numbers 01,02,03,04. This is a concept board, not a render of implemented software.
